description: This is the list type we use to hold the list of
OS jobs being tracked for each PTF job. There
will normally only be one OS job per PTF job,
except in the case of tightly integrated parallel jobs or jobs with multiple tasks.

attributes.name: OS_job_ID2
description: OS job id (upper 32 bits). @todo Replace the two id fields by one uint64_t?

attributes.name: systemd_scope
description: When the job is running in a systemd scope, this field contains the name of the scope.

attributes.name: usage_collection
description: Usage collection mode used for the os job.

attributes.name: ja_task_ID
description: In case of an array job: Task number of an array task.

attributes.name: task_id_str
description: In case of a tightly integrated parallel job: Pe Task Id String.

attributes.name: pid_list
description: List of process Ids belonging to this job/task.
